remarks: Welcome home to this cherished 3+ bedroom Cape Cod nestled in the heart of the Village of Angola! Ideally situated on a corner lot, this inviting home offers classic character, flexible living space, and a beautiful setting. A brick wall and shaggy bark hickory trees line the front yard, creating a picturesque welcome to this well-loved property. Inside, a spacious eat-in kitchen opens into the living room, where a charming built-in corner cabinet adds to the home's timeless appeal. The former garage has been thoughtfully converted into a generous family room featuring a fireplace, providing a wonderful space for relaxing and gathering with family and friends. A convenient first-floor bedroom and full bath offer added flexibility and ease. Upstairs, you will find two additional bedrooms plus a versatile pass-through space that could serve as a home office, playroom, reading area, or additional sleeping space. The second floor also includes a half bath with the potential to be remodeled into a full bath. This home offers several desirable updates, including a newer roof and windows, new storm doors, new concrete sidewalks and back patio, and central air conditioning. The The front and side exterior doors have been replaced. The refrigerator was updated in 2025. Hardwood flooring is located under the majority of the carpets, offering an exciting opportunity to uncover and showcase the home's original character. The basement provides additional storage and utility space, while the garage features a walk-up second story for even more storage. Outside, beautiful perennial flowers and grapevines frame the back patio, creating a charming and inviting setting to relax and enjoy the seasons. Full of character, flexibility, and small-town charm, this wonderful home and is ready for its next chapter. Enjoy a fabulous village location with restaurants and shops just two blocks away! When you need to get to the city, Buffalo is approximately a 30-minute drive, and several beautiful beaches are also within a short drive. This is a wonderful opportunity to enjoy the comfort of village living while remaining conveniently close to recreation, dining, shopping, and the city.
